title: Public Hearing on the draft Guidelines on outsourcing, reliance on customer due diligence performed by another obliged entity and other third-party arrangements

paras.text: Public input on these draft Guidelines is essential to ensure that the expectations they contain are clear, proportionate and effective, and can be applied in practice by obliged entities across the financial and non-financial sectors.

These Draft Guidelines set out specific principles and rules obliged entities should apply when establishing outsourcing pursuant to Article 18 of the AMLR, reliance on customer due diligence performed by other obliged entities pursuant to Articles 48 and 49 of the AMLR, and address other third-party arrangements under the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing and non-implementation and evasion of targeted financial sanctions (AML/CFT/TFS) framework as AMLA’s own-initiative guidelines pursuant to Article 54(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1620.

These Draft Guidelines are addressed to obliged entities as defined in Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 and supervisors as defined in Article 2(1) point (45) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 responsible for supervising these obliged entities compliance with their AML/CFT/TFS obligations.
Data Protection : Please find more information on how your personal data is being processed upon registration for the Public Hearing sessions in the Privacy Statement .
Book your seat, 2 months left to register, registration will end on Wednesday 10 February 2027, 14:00 (CET)
